cape-blue.role: Primary. Actions, links, brand mark, focus.

deep-cape.role: Pressed and hover state for Cape Blue.

sky.role: Secondary data series and highlights. Graphics only.

mist-blue.role: Tinted fills behind blue text and selected states.

spark-orange.role: The spark. Logo, AI moments, one highlight per screen. Pair with dark text, never white.

ember.role: Orange for text on light backgrounds.

midnight.role: Wordmark, dark brand surfaces, headings in marketing.

graphite.role: Secondary interface text. Dark enough to stay AA on translucent gray fills.

alert.role: Status: at risk and errors. Functional only.

interface.stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif
interface.use: All product UI. No webfont is loaded.
